baseline.title: Take a “before” photo
baseline.body: A photo before the operation makes every later comparison clearer.

care.title: Today's care checklist
care.body: Many clinics advise these in the first two weeks. Your own clinic's instructions come first.

photo.weeklyBody: Weekly for the first three months — same angle, same light.
photo.monthlyBody: Monthly from month four — same angle, same light.

shed.title: Log today's shedding
shed.body: Shedding in weeks 2–8 is commonly seen. A quick count helps you see the pattern over time.

prp.title: Session {{current}} of {{total}} is planned
prp.bodyToday: Today is the planned day. A photo before the session keeps your series comparable.
prp.bodyLate: Planned for {{date}}. Mark it done once it has happened.

setDate.title: Set your operation date
setDate.body: Kök uses the date to show your day, week and phase, and to plan photo reminders.
setDate.prpBody: Kök plans your sessions from it and reminds you the day before each one.

pre.title: Before your operation
pre.body: Many people find these helpful in the days before. Your clinic's instructions come first.
pre.tip1: Take “before” photos from the front, top and sides in good light.
pre.tip2: Ask your clinic for their written aftercare instructions.
pre.tip3: Plan a few quiet days after the operation.
pre.tip4: Have a travel pillow ready for sleeping with your head raised.
pre.clinicNote: Questions about medicines or your health? Ask your clinic or a doctor.

previewCard.title: Preview a style
previewCard.body: An AI preview to explore ideas — not a prediction of your result.

shedPeek.title: Recent shedding
shedPeek.note: Shedding in weeks 2–8 is commonly seen.

maturation.title: When is the result judged?
maturation.note: Hair typically keeps maturing for about {{months}} months after the operation.
maturation.evaluate12: Clinics typically evaluate the result at around 12 months.
maturation.evaluate18: Clinics typically look at the result around 12 months, and the crown or parting can keep maturing up to 18 months.
maturation.clinicNote: Individual results vary — your clinic sets your own check-ups.

photos.limitReached: {{limit}} free photos used — Pro keeps unlimited photos
photos.compareHint: Pick two photos to compare them.
photos.emptyBody: Take one photo per angle. Next time a faint ghost of it helps you line up the same view.
photos.emptyFilter: No photos from this angle yet.

plan.intro: Photo checkpoints at the months clinics commonly look at. Same angle, same light.
plan.note: A checkpoint counts with any photo from one week before to two weeks after it.

prp.timelineBody: Courses are commonly planned as a few sessions a few weeks apart, then maintenance. Your clinic sets your own plan.
prp.emptyBody: Start with a common plan: {{sessions}} sessions, {{weeks}} weeks apart. You can change every date.
prp.intro: Tick a session once it has happened. A photo before each one keeps your series comparable.
prp.maintenanceBody: Many clinics suggest a maintenance session about {{months}} months later — around {{date}}.
